I submitted the dispute for DD-51123 for owner approval. It passed validation on the second attempt.

The first attempt was rejected because I cited the ticket evidence, which the system treats as neutral rather than supporting. The submitted version cites only the pickup record: ready at 18:36, picked up at 18:40. It still mentions that the ticket lists Veg Momo (Fried), but without an evidence citation.

I left out the repeat-claimant count because it could read as a comment on the customer.
